name: UAP bundled asset and font rights registry
rule: Every bundled image/font/audio/video/model asset under web/public and web/src/avatar must have a row here with its exact sha256, its origin and a license from LICENSE-POLICY.json assetLicenses. scripts/audit-rights.mjs fails on unregistered assets, hash mismatches, incomplete rows and registry rows whose file no longer exists.

assets.origin: authored in-repo for this platform (geometric node badge); no upstream mascot or traced artwork
